gt_summary: Kuznets-corrected STIRPAT: log(CDE) = a + w_GDP*log(GDP) + w_GDP2*log(GDP)^2 + w_TP*log(TP) + w_AP*log(AP) + w_DP*log(DP) + w_UR*log(UR) + w_AT*log(AT+273.15)
submission_summary: Pure power-law STIRPAT: CDE = K * GDP^0.75 * TP^1 * AP^3.5 * UR^0.5 * (AT+10)^-0.25 * DP^-0.125
matched: Log-linear (power-law) skeleton in all 6 input variables
Correct sign on all elasticities: positive GDP, TP, AP, UR; negative DP, AT
Uses exp(sum of log terms) structure matching GT outer family
missed: Missing Kuznets quadratic log(GDP)^2 curvature term — the key GT correction making GDP elasticity income-dependent
AT offset is +10 instead of +273.15 (Kelvin conversion) — changes the functional shape of temperature dependence
coefficient_assessment: Signs are consistent with GT. Magnitudes differ (e.g., GDP elasticity fixed at 0.75 vs GT ~2.39 linear + quadratic correction; AP elasticity 3.5 vs GT 3.57; TP ~1.0 vs GT ~1.02). The missing quadratic term is the main structural gap.
